svg.title: OmniRoute compression pipeline: a client request of 10,000 tokens passes through 12 stacked engines — Session-Dedup, CCR, Lite, RTK, Responses Tool Output, Headroom, Relevance, Caveman, Aggressive, LLMLingua-2, Ultra, OmniGlyph — and reaches the provider at about 1,080 tokens, up to 95% saved. The default stacked combo runs RTK then Caveman (average 89.2%, range 78.4–94.6%). Code, URLs and JSON are always preserved byte-perfect.
svg.desc: Animated token funnel on an 8 s loop: five token dots leave the client, four evaporate at engines along the way, the survivor and the untouched code token reach the provider while the twelve engine cells light up in sequence.
svg.text: { } code · URLs · JSON — always preserved byte-perfect
